async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Sample Page' link to navigate to a page that might have a search bar
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Sample Page").click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Look for a search bar using accessibility roles
    # First, try to find a searchbox role
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox")
    if await search_box.count() > 0:
        await search_box.fill("playbook")
        await search_box.press("Enter")
    else:
        # If no searchbox, look for a textbox with a name containing 'Search'
        search_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search")
        if await search_input.count() > 0:
            await search_input.fill("playbook")
            await search_input.press("Enter")
        else:
            # Fallback: look for any textbox with a name that might indicate search
            all_textboxes = page.get_by_role("textbox")
            count_tb = await all_textboxes.count()
            for i in range(count_tb):
                name = await all_textboxes.nth(i).get_attribute("aria-label") or await all_textboxes.nth(i).get_attribute("name")
                if name and "search" in name.lower():
                    await all_textboxes.nth(i).fill("playbook")
                    await all_textboxes.nth(i).press("Enter")
                    break
            else:
                raise Exception("Search bar not found")
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Identify search results as links
    result_links = page.get_by_role("link")
    count = await result_links.count()
    if count >= 2:
        # Click the second-to-last result
        await result_links.nth(count - 2).click()
    else:
        raise Exception("Not enough search results found")
    # Wait for navigation after clicking the result
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
